mapper.sql: id, workflow_id, step_no, step_type, title, status, tool_name, proposal_id, input_summary, output_summary, error_code, started_time, completed_time, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_workflow_step (workflow_id, step_no, step_type, title, status, tool_name, proposal_id, input_summary, output_summary, error_code, started_time, completed_time, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{stepNo}, #{stepType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{toolName}, #{proposalId}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{errorCode}, #{startedTime}, #{completedTime}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_workflow_step WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY step_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_workflow_step SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END, edit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by = #{editBy} WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_USER_CONFIRMATION')

UPDATE t_ai_workflow_step SET status = #{status}, proposal_id = #{proposalId}, output_summary = #{outputSummary}, error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END, edit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by = #{editBy} WHERE id = #{id}
